behavior-tests.source: Stock Overclock capture supplies the +43 viral modifier at the captured level, 20-second term, and a 90-second reuse. The GOB lists viral influence as the affected stat.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityBuffs adds and expires the Overclock record. AbilityStats scales viral health damage from active influence.
behavior-tests.test: HackerTargetingBehaviorBatchMode checks the distinct +43 record, reuse, expiration, and Logic Barrage damage against the same clear target before, during and after the modifier.

behavior-tests.source: The stock 7a4fc7efcf1c Logic Barrage 4.0 activation and captured base hit 424. GOB 330 marks viral health damage.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityTargets uses the retained base and AbilityStats scales it by current influence. AbilityCooldowns applies four seconds to the move and group 683.
behavior-tests.test: HackerTargetingBehaviorBatchMode replays the stock selected-target activation on a clear dummy, proves 640/822/640 with the fixture's observed influence records, and asserts both cooldown records. FreeCastViralLandingTests checks that deflection gates all effects.
